text:
maria: Heads up — overnight EU-west ingest backlog hit ~6h, GPU-hour consumption spiked ~2.4x between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Seeing kafka consumer lag plus telemetry-proxy 504s. Suspect intermittent network flaps to the kafka-proxy cluster.

infra-bot: [ALERT] topic=usage-raw partition_lag > 100k (detected) :fire:

alex: :eyes: Any config changes pushed last night? rolling deploys?

sara: No config changes from apps. I pulled telemetry-proxy logs around 02:12 — saw a few connect timeouts: 
```
2026-03-15T02:12:14Z telemetry-proxy ERROR upstream request failed: dial tcp 10.12.5.7:9092: i/o timeout
2026-03-15T02:12:16Z telemetry-proxy WARN retrying request (attempt=2)
```

tony: HPA never scaled because metrics-server evicted on those nodes (OOM). CPU metrics missing -> HPA scale decisions stalled. Filed INF-3942.

oncall: pinged infra oncall. will stand by for mitigation.

maria: Quick mitigations I propose: 1) temporarily add 16 GPUs to forecast-worker pool (16->32) for immediate capacity, 2) start a replay backfill with limited rate, 3) lift autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash. Need cost approval for bump.

nina: approved. Also set replay parallelism 8->16 and enable per-partition reader.

alex: For replay, let's throttle to avoid downstream storage/replicate storms. Suggested command:
```
kubectl run replay-job --rm --restart=OnFailure --image=redwood/replay:prod -- \
  /bin/replay --topic usage-raw --max-messages 10000 --rate 2000 --parallel 16
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for telemetry-proxy v2.1.4 -> v2.1.6 (3 pods) :rocket:

sara: Dashboard action items: add panels for consumer_lag (p50/p95), ingress_kbps, kafka_proxy_errors, gpu_utilization by pool. New alert proposal: consumer_lag > 50k for 10m -> severity=high.

maria: Root-cause hypothesis: transient network flaps to kafka-proxy cluster caused consumer retries -> increased processing time -> metrics-server eviction due to node memory pressure -> HPA saw stale/absent metrics -> scale gap. Sequence: network flap -> consumer lag -> backlog -> temp GPU shortage for catch-up.

james: Quick cost estimate: extra 16 GPUs for ~2h = 32 GPU-hours. Backfill expected ~6h at 32 GPUs = 192 GPU-hours. Total ~224 GPU-hours. I'll map to cost sheet and post numbers.

maria: Follow-ups: - INF-3942 for metrics-server stability - add fallback HPA metric (custom consumer_lag gauge) - set autoscaler cooldown to 2m min scale interval - add synthetic consumer load test to CI to validate autoscaling - add network path health probes for kafka-proxy endpoints.

alex: Also recommend consumer client change: prefer incremental backoff with jitter and surface retry metrics to prometheus.

maria: Starting backfill tonight 22:00 UTC with throttle flags. Will monitor dashboards and post updates here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: Backfill started 2026-03-15T22:00Z, initial replay 10k msgs successful, consumer_lag down to ~12k. Closing loop, will follow up in INF-3942 and the dashboard PR.
